title: SONTARA® WINDOW WIPES – 25/Bag, 12”x13.25”, 1000/BX
description: Gentle on aircraft transparencies, very low lint, solvent resistant with high-strength both wet and dry. Exceptionally clean with no contaminants like shop rags or shop towels.
